'''Barton''' is an NPC in {{Location|Fool's Elysium|nocat=1}} and a member of the [[Troupe of Fools]]. he can be seen talking with [[Mosi]] during the day about the Order's new play.

{{Quests and Events}}

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Barton''' This... this... is yet another baseless slander!
:'''Barton''' If this religious play actually gets performed, how will my wife and daughter see me? How will the rest of the town see them?
:'''Barton''' How are they supposed to live in Ragunna after this? Damn it!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Mosi:''' Have you finished reading the Order's new play? What do you think?
:'''Barton''' Same tired themes again. Praising the doctrine, dictating morality... Always painting those sent on the Pilgrim's Sail as the scum of the earth.
:'''Mosi:''' Exactly! By the end of it, I almost felt like marching straight back to the city and slapping every one of them, just to show them how ridiculous their little play really is.
:'''Barton''' If all we're after is revenge, might as well join Aldric and become pirates. Go after Ragunna's merchant ships, raid the Order's Acolytes, take whatever we want.
:'''Barton''' But that'd make us no better than the heretics they love to write about in their dramas.
:'''Barton''' There would be no turning back. We'd have no voice left, no way to clear our names or expose Fenrico's lies.
:'''Barton''' We'd just have to watch everyone we love become tools used by the Order.
:'''Mosi:''' ...That's not the life I want.
:'''Mosi:''' I still want our story to be seen. The real story. Let the world see who we truly are.
:'''Barton''' Alright then, Mask up. Let's run through another scene.
:'''Barton''' This Carnevale, we aren't who we used to be in Ragunna—we're the Fools who fight for equality, for freedom. That's who we must become.
{{Dialogue End}}
